module_summary: COBS encoder for AXI-stream: an input FSM counts segment bytes into a data FIFO and pushes code bytes into a code FIFO; an output FSM interleaves codes and data through a skid-buffered output register.

anchors.name: input_state_reg
anchors.why: Input encoder FSM: idle, segment, final-zero, append-zero; drives FIFO pushes and input ready mask.

anchors.name: output_state_reg
anchors.why: Output FSM alternating between emitting a code byte and streaming segment data bytes.

anchors.name: input_count_reg
anchors.why: Segment length counter forming the COBS code byte; wraps at 254 bytes.

anchors.name: output_count_reg
anchors.why: Counts remaining data bytes of current segment, loaded from code byte, ends segment output.

anchors.name: fail_frame_reg
anchors.why: Remembers errored frame (tuser) to emit error code and tuser on frame close.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready_mask
anchors.why: FSM-driven mask blocking input acceptance while final/append zero codes are pushed.

anchors.name: s_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Raw input byte stream; zero bytes terminate segments, others go to data FIFO.

anchors.name: s_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Input stream valid; with tready advances the input encoder FSM.

anchors.name: s_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input ready: both FIFOs ready and FSM mask set.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Encoded COBS output byte stream from the output register.

anchors.name: m_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output stream valid driven by output register valid.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling skid buffer transfers to output register.

anchors.name: code_fifo_in_tdata
anchors.why: Computed COBS code byte (segment count, 1, 2 or 0) pushed into code FIFO.

anchors.name: code_fifo_in_tready
anchors.why: Code FIFO ready gating input ready and final/append zero code pushes.

anchors.name: code_fifo_out_tdata
anchors.why: Code byte read from code FIFO, output and used to load output segment counter.

anchors.name: code_fifo_out_tvalid
anchors.why: Code FIFO has a code byte; starts output of next segment in idle state.

anchors.name: data_fifo_out_tvalid
anchors.why: Data FIFO has a byte; enables segment data transfer in output FSM.

anchors.name: m_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Muxed code or data byte feeding the output skid buffer.

anchors.name: m_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal registered ready gating output FSM transfers and skid buffer stores.

anchors.name: temp_m_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register holding a byte when output is stalled.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable moving internal byte directly into output register.

groups.name: input_encoder
groups.description: Input FSM splitting bytes into segments, counting length, generating code bytes.

groups.name: code_fifo
groups.description: 256-deep FIFO holding COBS code bytes with error flag.

groups.name: data_fifo
groups.description: 256-deep FIFO holding non-zero segment data bytes.

groups.name: output_sequencer
groups.description: Output FSM emitting a code byte then its segment's data bytes.

groups.name: output_skid_buffer
groups.description: Output register plus temp register skid buffer for AXI-stream backpressure.
